ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. has approved an open market share buyback of up to ₹697 million (9.99% of paid-up capital and free reserves) at a maximum price of ₹500, representing a significant premium of over 58% to recent market prices. This initiative, which excludes promoters and will be funded entirely by internal resources, aims to enhance shareholder value by improving EPS and signals strong financial health. No material red flags are identified, with the company confirming strict adherence to regulatory compliance.
